scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) — Gramin and Urban
eligibility_text: Households without a pucca (permanent) house, assessed against state-specific priority lists (PMAY-Gramin) or income/asset criteria for EWS/LIG/MIG categories (PMAY-Urban). No existing pucca house anywhere in India.
benefits: Central financial assistance toward constructing a pucca house, amount varying by category (rural/urban, plain/hilly) and revised periodically; PMAY-Urban 2.0 (announced 2024) restructured the urban income/subsidy slabs.
source_note: Subsidy amounts and urban slabs have changed multiple times (most recently PMAY-U 2.0) — verify current figures on pmayg.gov.in / pmay-urban.gov.in before quoting a rupee amount in the demo.
